blocks.html: Read the exact coordinates and elevation of any point on the map by dropping the Red X on it.

slides.title: Turn on the Red X tool
slides.html: Tap the White X on the toolbar to toggle the Red X tool into a movable state. The icon turns yellow.

slides.title: Tap to read a location
slides.html: While the icon is yellow, tap anywhere on the map and the Red X jumps there. The widget in the upper right shows that point's coordinates, elevation and range and bearing.

slides.title: Lock or disable it
slides.html:
Tap the toolbar icon again to lock the Red X to its current spot.

  • Long press the Red X icon on the toolbar to disable the tool.
  • Note: the Red X is not saved when ATAK is closed and reopened.

slides.title: Open the radial menu for more
slides.html:
Tap the Red X on the map to open its radial menu. From here you can:

  • Fine Adjust the position
  • drop a Range and Bearing Line
  • turn on the Compass Overlay or Polar Coordinates
  • Pair to Self or Place a Marker

Long press the yellow arrow to reach the sub-radial menus.
